data: Microsoft's total revenue was about $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023 (ended June 30, 2023) and about $281.7 billion in fiscal 2025 (ended June 30, 2025). That is an increase of roughly $69.8 billion, or about 32.9% over the two years. These figures are from my training data, so check them against Microsoft's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
